Creative Direction
for a Music Artist.

Creative direction · Music · 2025

Building the whole visual world around an artist's music.

An artist had the music but no visual world to go with it. So I built one. I usually shoot my own ideas, but this time I was shaping someone else's identity — turning their sound into something you could see. First time directing a vision that wasn't mine. I loved it.
